title: Heat Bench
kicker: Why reactions get hot or cold
desc: Why some reactions get hot and others get cold: pick a reaction, watch a calorimeter, and see the same energy on a Hess's-law diagram.

title: Moon Phases
desc: Why the Moon has phases: move the Moon round its orbit and see how much of its always-lit half faces Earth.

title: Planet Scales
desc: Your mass never changes, but your weight does. See the same body on all eight planets.

title: Spectacle Bench
desc: How spectacles work: change the eye length and the lens power and watch light focus on, in front of, or behind the retina.

title: Town Bank
desc: Why prices go up: pump new money into a small town's bank and watch the price tags in the bakery window climb.

title: Valley Flood
desc: Raise the water over a real East Tennessee landscape and watch it fill the lowest valley, wait behind a ridge, then spill over and claim far more land.

title: Pendulum Lab
desc: Why a pendulum keeps time, and when it stops being exact.

title: Prism Room
desc: Why white light splits in a prism: refraction, minimum deviation, total internal reflection, and putting the colours back together.
